project_name: FinCFO (Budggt v2 Inspired) - Personal AI Finance CFO
archetype: Bibit & Stockbit Inspired - High Performance Fintech & AI Advisor
target_audience: Indonesian Gen-Z & Millennials seeking effortless financial control with AI guidance

currency_and_localization.formatting_rules: Format numbers with Indonesian thousand separator dot, e.g. Rp 12.500.000
currency_and_localization.default_language: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) with English tech terms (e.g., Net Worth, Budget, AI Advisor)

layout_and_grid.sidebar_navigation: Sticky left navigation on desktop (collapsible), bottom navigation bar on mobile screen

components: Net Worth Banner with Privacy Eye Toggle (Hide/Show amounts)
Financial Health Score Gauge (0-100 with actionable feedback badge)
Quick Action Bar (Scan Struk, Tambah Transaksi, Tanya AI, Transfer)
Wallet Summary Slider (BCA, Mandiri, GoPay, OVO, Dana, ShopeePay, Credit Card, PayLater)
Monthly Budget Progress Bar & Overbudget Alerts
Recent Transactions List with Category Badges & AI Tag

ai_financial_advisor.name: CFO AI Assistant (Bagus AI)
capabilities: Personalized financial advice based on user spending history
Prompt suggestions (e.g. 'Berapa sisa budget makan minggu ini?', 'Bagaimana cara kurangi pengeluaran GoFood?')
Interactive conversational UI with streaming response effect

savings_goals.card_style: Progress bar with target deadline countdown, target amount vs saved amount, and deposit modal

visuals: Spending Trend Line Chart (Recharts / Shadcn Chart)
Cash Flow Summary (Income vs Expense vs Savings Rate)

methods: Google Social Login button (mocked with OAuth flow)
authentication.user_profile: Indonesian avatar with level badge (e.g. 'Pro CFO Level 2')

component_library_mapping.primitives: Shadcn/UI components (Dialog, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Select, Switch, Progress, Sheet, Tooltip, Avatar, Badge, Button)
component_library_mapping.charts: Recharts with custom Bibit/Stockbit emerald & dark theme tooltips
component_library_mapping.icons: lucide-react for UI icons, @phosphor-icons/react for duotone accents
component_library_mapping.animations: framer-motion for smooth list entry, tab switching, and dialog transitions

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every interactive element, tab, button, input, balance card, and modal must contain data-testid in kebab-case format.

universal_guidelines.no_center_app_container: Do NOT center align the main application container (.App { text-align: center }). Maintain standard left-aligned readable dashboard layout.
universal_guidelines.no_universal_transition: Do NOT apply 'transition: all' globally. Use target transitions for background-color, border-color, and opacity.
universal_guidelines.no_ai_emojis_as_icons: Do NOT use AI emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for primary UI icons. Use SVG icons from lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
universal_guidelines.generous_spacing: Use 2x padding inside card containers (p-6) to prevent text collision with borders.
universal_guidelines.privacy_mode_behavior: When privacy mode is ON, all currency amounts must blur or display 'Rp •••••••' while preserving the UI height and layout stability.
universal_guidelines.file_type: JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) as specified in the environment.
